title: Knowledge check: Understanding the Vue Application Architecture

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Understanding the Vue Application Architecture”?
options: Vue is a database engine for storing server records.
Vue replaces HTML and CSS with a single language.
Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
Vue requires manual DOM mutation for every state change.
questions.answer_key: Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Understanding the Vue Application Architecture directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: For “Browser, DOM, and JavaScript”, which practice is most reliable?
options: Vue replaces HTML and CSS with a single language.
Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
Vue requires manual DOM mutation for every state change.
Vue is a database engine for storing server records.
questions.answer_key: Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
questions.explanation: This practice supports the syllabus subtopic “Browser, DOM, and JavaScript”. Check the expected result and a relevant boundary or failure case.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Understanding the Vue Application Architecture” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.

review_note: Answer keys and explanations are server-side data. Human review required before publication.
